answer: Polling station volunteer roster with election-day logs is the check: volunteer shifts logged at the same polling station for years. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The velvet signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm faking 158 aliases needs 158 separate volunteer rosters, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The bridge ledger records each payment, the orchard window resets the board, and 158 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
